map.矩形双向板：按长边/短边比查系数，求跨中、支座两向弯矩分配配筋。: Rectangular two-way slabs: look up the coefficient from the long-to-short side ratio to get the moments in both directions at mid-span and supports and distribute the steel.
map.连续双向板：分中间区、边区、角区采用不同系数，角部负弯矩大需加筋。: Continuous two-way slabs use different coefficients for the interior, edge and corner panels, and the large negative corner moment needs extra steel.
map.厚度与挠度：双向板厚一般由刚度与冲切控制，配筋在板带内调整。: Thickness and deflection: two-way slab thickness is usually governed by stiffness and punching, with the steel adjusted within the slab strip.
map.方形双向板弯矩系数: Moment coefficient of a square two-way slab
map.3m×3m 四边固定双向板、q=10kN/m²：查系数跨中 mx=my≈0.03: For a 3 m × 3 m slab fixed on all four edges with q = 10 kN/m²: the tabulated mid-span coefficients give mx = my ≈ 0.036·q² ≈ 0.036 × 10 × 9 ≈ 3.24 kN·m/m. Provide bottom steel in both directions and additional negative steel in the support zones.
map.双向板系数怎么查？: How do I look up the two-way slab coefficients?
map.按边界条件（简支/固定）与 Lx/Ly 查弯矩系数表（如塑性铰线法），边区角区系: Use the moment coefficient table by boundary condition (simply supported or fixed) and Lx/Ly, for example the yield-line method. Edge and corner coefficients differ, so you cannot use the mid-span value over the whole slab.
map.为什么不按单向配筋？: Why not reinforce it as a one-way slab?
map.短边/长边<2 时两向均受力，只配短向会漏掉长向弯矩，角部上翘需负筋，误配易开裂: When the short-to-long side ratio is below 2 both directions act. Reinforcing only the short direction misses the long-span moment, and the upturned corners need negative steel, so mis-reinforcement leads to cracking.
map.板厚怎么定？: How is the slab thickness set?
map.双向板厚常取短跨 1/40~1/50 并满足冲切与最小厚，太大不经济、太小挠度裂: Two-way slabs often take 1/40 to 1/50 of the short span while satisfying punching and the minimum thickness. Too thick is uneconomic, too thin gives excessive deflection and crack width, so size it from the span first and then check.
